decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.21 Runtime Status CLI for release.
rationale: Visionary: qif status improves agent and operator orientation before action. Builder: implementation composes existing local checks and catalogs instead of adding a new package type or external dependency. Guardian: verifier boundaries are explicit and status does not claim semantic quality truth, business approval correctness, operational safety, or roadmap correctness.
recommendation: Release v0.6.21 after final structural checks, residue scan, commit, tag, and GitHub Release.
